CODE
Art. 2.3.57. 
Rule for children in common
Where there are children of both spouses, a matrimonial agreement granting an advantage resulting from the manner of composition, operation, liquidation or division of the joint patrimony is considered, with respect to them, as a gift in respect of the share exceeding half attributed to the surviving spouse in the value, on the day of their attribution, of the present or future property which the predeceased spouse has included in the joint patrimony by express stipulation in the matrimonial agreement.
 A child of one of the spouses who has been the subject of a simple or full adoption by the other spouse is considered to be a child of both spouses.
